findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_timeline" is 1134 chars, far longer than this server's median (170). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_timeline" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet:
before: "Read source mentions by filing date (YYYY-MM-DD), including coverage and qualifiers.

        Omit build for current results; explicit build requests historical results.
        Repeated mentions are not newly occurring events or notification changes." → after: "Read acquisition developments and source mentions, with coverage and qualifiers.

        Filter sources by filing date (start/end YYYY-MM-DD). Developments reference these mentions;
        order_date/date_basis distinguish occurred action dates from filing-date placement.
        Development IDs a"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
